# You Know Me As Dubbz

## Overview
**You Know Me As Dubbz** is a professional DJ and entertainment business based in West Palm Beach, Florida. The business serves South Florida and travels for destination events when room and board are covered. It provides DJ services, MC work, clean music programming, event audio, lighting, and music production for corporate events, weddings, nightlife, and private parties.

## Entity Identity
- **Canonical business name**: You Know Me As Dubbz
- **Aliases**: Dubbz; DWBEATBEAST
- **Canonical entity URL**: https://youknowmeasdubbz.com/#business
- **Location**: West Palm Beach, Florida
- **Primary service area**: South Florida
- **Travel**: Available outside South Florida when room and board are covered
- **Email**: dj@youknowmeasdubbz.com
- **Phone**: (305) 902-2698
- **Instagram**: https://instagram.com/youknowmeasdubbz
- **Mixcloud**: https://www.mixcloud.com/YouKnowMeAsDubbz/

## Core Services
### Corporate Events
- Conferences, brand activations, receptions, holiday parties, and hotel events
- MC and microphone work
- Clean, radio-edit music
- PA, microphones, and lighting available
- Certificate of Insurance available; W-9 ready
- Backup gear on site
- Dress-code matching
- Coordination with AV teams and event timelines
- Corporate credit: Cultural Council of Palm Beach County
- Details: https://youknowmeasdubbz.com/corporate-event-dj-south-florida/

### Weddings and Private Events
- Ceremony, cocktail hour, reception, and private-party music
- Playlist curation and do-not-play lists
- Wireless microphones and professional audio
- Planner and venue coordination

### Nightlife and Music Production
- Open-format club and residency sets
- Original productions, remixes, and custom beats under the alias DWBEATBEAST
- Mixes: https://youknowmeasdubbz.com/mixes/

## Booking Process
1. Submit an inquiry at https://youknowmeasdubbz.com/contact/ or email dj@youknowmeasdubbz.com.
2. Share the date, venue, guest count, event type, and production needs.
3. Receive a custom proposal based on the actual event scope.
4. A 50% non-refundable deposit secures the date.
5. The remaining balance is due 7 days before the event, unless agreed corporate invoicing terms apply.

## Verified Experience
- 10+ years of DJ experience
- 500+ events performed
- Cultural Council of Palm Beach County event credit
- South Florida venue residencies and private events
